from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationPaper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[CitationPaper]
